title: House and unit prices forecast to grow in 2025
paragraphs: According to KPMG’s latestResidential Property Market Outlook, house prices across Australia are expected to rise 3.3 per cent over the year, followed by a stronger 6 per cent in 2026.
Canberra and Melbourne are expected to rise by 3.5 per cent, Sydney by 3.3 per cent, and Brisbane by 3.1 per cent.
Unit prices are forecast to rise by 5 per cent in Sydney and Perth in 2025.
